project.name: CSD Onboarding
project.subtitle: A clearer journey, a better experience.
project.purpose: Help CSD team members understand the service ecosystem, operational workflow, stakeholder responsibilities and student placement journey.
audience: Existing CSD team members seeking a shared overview
project.designPrinciple: Design for CSD onboarding while keeping the student experience at the centre.
project.sourcePolicy: Use supplied project research as the source of truth. Do not invent official policies, metrics, deadlines, or unsupported stakeholder relationships.

communicationPrinciples.title: Be clear
communicationPrinciples.description: State the opportunity, required action, relevant date and next step.

communicationPrinciples.title: Be structured
communicationPrinciples.description: Use consistent information formats so essential details are easy to find.

communicationPrinciples.title: Be timely
communicationPrinciples.description: Share confirmed updates when available and flag changes clearly.

communicationPrinciples.title: Be transparent
communicationPrinciples.description: Distinguish confirmed information from pending decisions.

communicationPrinciples.title: Clarify ownership
communicationPrinciples.description: Make the next action and responsible contact clear wherever known.

scenarios.title: A student profile is incomplete
scenarios.situation: The information needed to assess a student against a role is missing.
scenarios.consider: Which information is missing, who can confirm it, and when is it needed?
scenarios.response: Identify the specific gap, request the missing information from the appropriate person, and avoid assuming suitability until the information is confirmed.

scenarios.title: A company has not responded
scenarios.situation: The selection outcome is still pending.
scenarios.consider: What is confirmed, what remains unknown, and who needs an update?
scenarios.response: Verify the latest known status, coordinate a follow-up through the appropriate contact, and communicate the uncertainty honestly without promising an unconfirmed date.

scenarios.title: A role may not fit a student's profile
scenarios.situation: The role requirements and student information do not appear to align.
scenarios.consider: Which requirements are essential, and what evidence supports the assessment?
scenarios.response: Compare the documented role requirements with the student's profile and seek clarification from the relevant stakeholders before making assumptions.

scenarios.title: A student has missed an update
scenarios.situation: A student may not have noticed an opportunity or deadline.
scenarios.consider: Was the information clear, accessible and shared through the intended channel?
scenarios.response: Check the original communication and confirmed deadline, clarify the situation with the appropriate contact, and identify whether communication can be made clearer next time.
